label: POST-HOC
purpose: Nine new comparisons only. The panel and preceding native-tail results have already been inspected. This is not a new untouched confirmation.
panel: Later panel only: identical saved split-2 market dates from 2015 to February 2022; exactly 28 markets and 50,073 matched observations.
native: Reuse the completed native five-density VaR/ES forecasts exactly; no inference rerun, training, recalibration or changes to earlier results.

gjr.first_origin: First scored later-panel observation of each market
gjr.optimizer: One arch default start per scheduled fit, maxiter=1000; existing strict convergence/parameter checks.
gjr.failure_policy: A rejected refit carries the previous accepted parameters, with no rescue fits. An initial failure or invalid daily filter makes that market/model unavailable. Record every failed attempt.
gjr.tails: mu + sqrt(variance) times the unit-variance Student-t lower-tail VaR/ES.

fhs.scale: Same accepted GJR-t fits, fitted constant mean, conditional variance and refit schedule as the new GJR-GARCH-t comparator.
fhs.residuals: At each accepted fit, compute (r-mu)/conditional_sigma on that 1000-return training window, excluding its first observation as in Chapter 7 FHS. Use the existing empirical_var_es fractional-boundary rule.
fhs.forecast: Freeze residual quantile/ES until the next accepted refit; update conditional scale causally each day. Add fitted mean to both tail values. If a GJR refit fails, retain the previous accepted residual pair and parameters.
fhs.failure_policy: Any invalid accepted-fit residual pair or incomplete scored path makes this market/model unavailable; no silent repair.

es_caviar.variant: Original SAV quantile recursion with multiplicative ES; use fit_es_caviar and caviar_path verbatim.
es_caviar.estimation: Fit once on first 1000 returns of each full market history at each alpha; recurse forward without refitting or retuning.
es_caviar.optimizer: Original 30 random starts, original ranges, Nelder-Mead, maxiter=4000, xatol=fatol=1e-6. Select strictly smallest objective exactly as original code.
es_caviar.scoring: Ignore old helper score summaries; evaluate issued raw VaR/ES with unchanged Chapter 7 FZ0.
es_caviar.acceleration: Optional Numba compilation of the unchanged caviar_path only, without fastmath/parallelism, after exact synthetic-path and objective parity tests. This does not alter starts, selection or optimiser settings.
es_caviar.failure_policy: Do not replace the legacy-selected candidate. If it is nonconverged, has invalid/sentinel objective, nonfinite parameters or invalid scored tail path, mark market/level unavailable and report it. Log all 30 candidate diagnostics.

comparisons.direction: native VolPFN minus new comparator; negative favours native
comparisons.holm: Holm across exactly these nine tests, separate from every preceding comparison.
comparisons.beats: Holm p < 0.05 and negative mean difference; a 95% interval including zero takes precedence and is a tie.
comparisons.worse: Positive difference with Holm p <0.05 and interval entirely above zero; otherwise no adjusted evidence.
comparisons.missing: Never omit failed markets to obtain a smaller-panel headline. Any incomplete 28-market comparison is unavailable, with descriptive estimate/interval/raw p withheld; use p=1 solely as its reserved Holm-family input.

scoring.units: 100 times decimal open-to-close log returns (percentage units)
scoring.comparator_policy: Use archived Chapter 7 original daily scores, with their historical optimiser acceptance policy; do not refit or silently replace them with convergence-checked sensitivity results.
scoring.matching: Exact market/date alignment across native, guard, GARCH FHS, GARCH-t, GAS and neural t8; require all 28 markets and all saved panel dates. No silent row dropping.
scoring.mean: Mean within market, then equal mean over 28 markets.

bootstrap.p: Two-sided fraction across zero, minimum 1/2000; same original implementation and joint calendar resampling.

matching: Use every existing later-panel native date, exact return/date equality with the saved native tails, and no row dropping. Reuse FZ0 E_FLOOR=1e-8, VaR cap=-1e-3, ES<=VaR-1e-6, percent log-return units, equal-market means and original paired_block bootstrap: seed927601, 2000 reps, circular 60-date blocks.
output: One nine-row results table and complete fit-failure diagnostics, plus new code/forecasts/provenance. No changes to earlier files or dissertation text.
